record.one_liner: Freshdesk provides a cloud-based customer support platform with a REST API supporting CRUD operations on tickets, contacts, agents, and more.
record.blocker: Authentication and access level details are not specified in the provided sources.

api_type.quote: Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category.

api_breadth.quote: Tickets Tickets Create a Ticket /api/v2/tickets Create an Outbound Email /api/v2/tickets/outbound_email View a Ticket /api/v2/tickets/[id]
